use crate::{ownership, runtime};
use nix::{
    libc,
    sys::signal::{Signal, kill},
    unistd::Pid,
};
use runtime::test_support::{
    self as hooks, Checkpoint, Dependencies, SignalTarget, Stream, TerminalRequest,
};
use runtime::{App, Invocation, Runtime, Snapshot};
use std::fs::{File, OpenOptions};
use std::io::{self, BufRead, BufReader, Read, Write};
use std::os::unix::net::{UnixListener, UnixStream};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::pin::Pin;
use std::sync::{
    Arc, Condvar, Mutex,
    atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicUsize, Ordering},
    mpsc,
};
use std::task::{Context, Poll};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use tokio::process::{Child, Command};

pub fn env(k: &str, v: impl AsRef<std::ffi::OsStr>) {
    unsafe { std::env::set_var(k, v) }
}
pub fn hex(b: &[u8]) -> String {
    b.iter().map(|v| format!("{v:02x}")).collect()
}
pub fn child(label: &str, mode: &str, out: &[u8], err: &[u8], code: i32) {
    for (k, v) in [
        ("P1_LABEL", label.to_owned()),
        ("P1_MODE", mode.to_owned()),
        ("P1_PREFIX_HEX", String::new()),
        ("P1_PAYLOAD_HEX", hex(out)),
        ("P1_STDERR_HEX", hex(err)),
        ("P1_EXIT", code.to_string()),
        ("P1_READYFILE", String::new()),
    ] {
        env(k, v)
    }
}
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Gate {
    entered: Mutex<usize>,
    cv: Condvar,
    released: AtomicBool,
}
impl Gate {
    pub fn hit(&self) {
        let mut n = self.entered.lock().unwrap();
        *n += 1;
        self.cv.notify_all();
        while !self.released.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
            n = self.cv.wait(n).unwrap()
        }
    }
    pub fn observe(&self) {
        let n = self.entered.lock().unwrap();
        let (n, t) = self
            .cv
            .wait_timeout_while(n, Duration::from_secs(4), |n| *n == 0)
            .unwrap();
        assert!(*n > 0 && !t.timed_out(), "barrier not entered")
    }
    pub fn release(&self) {
        self.released.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
        self.cv.notify_all()
    }
}
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub struct Bytes(pub Arc<Mutex<Vec<u8>>>);
impl Bytes {
    pub fn get(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        self.0.lock().unwrap().clone()
    }
}
impl tokio::io::AsyncWrite for Bytes {
    fn poll_write(self: Pin<&mut Self>, _: &mut Context<'_>, b: &[u8]) -> Poll<io::Result<usize>> {
        self.0.lock().unwrap().extend_from_slice(b);
        Poll::Ready(Ok(b.len()))
    }
    fn poll_flush(self: Pin<&mut Self>, _: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<io::Result<()>> {
        Poll::Ready(Ok(()))
    }
    fn poll_shutdown(self: Pin<&mut Self>, _: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<io::Result<()>> {
        Poll::Ready(Ok(()))
    }
}
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Fault(pub &'static str);
impl std::fmt::Display for Fault {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        f.write_str(self.0)
    }
}
impl std::error::Error for Fault {}
pub fn cause(error: &runtime::Error, token: &str) -> bool {
    let mut e: Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> = Some(error);
    while let Some(cur) = e {
        if let Some(io) = cur.downcast_ref::<io::Error>() {
            if io
                .get_ref()
                .and_then(|e| e.downcast_ref::<Fault>())
                .is_some_and(|f| f.0 == token)
            {
                return true;
            }
        }
        if cur.downcast_ref::<Fault>().is_some_and(|f| f.0 == token) {
            return true;
        }
        e = cur.source()
    }
    false
}
pub fn errno(error: &runtime::Error, code: i32) -> bool {
    let mut e: Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> = Some(error);
    while let Some(cur) = e {
        if cur
            .downcast_ref::<io::Error>()
            .is_some_and(|e| e.raw_os_error() == Some(code))
        {
            return true;
        }
        e = cur.source()
    }
    false
}
pub type StartHook = Arc<dyn Fn(&mut Command) -> io::Result<Child> + Send + Sync>;
pub type SignalHook = Arc<dyn Fn(SignalTarget, Signal) -> io::Result<()> + Send + Sync>;
pub type CheckHook = Arc<dyn Fn(Checkpoint, Arc<Invocation>) + Send + Sync>;
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Probe {
    pub starts: AtomicUsize,
    pub pids: Mutex<Vec<u32>>,
    pub waits: AtomicUsize,
    pub reaped: AtomicUsize,
    pub signals: Mutex<Vec<(SignalTarget, Signal)>>,
    pub invocations: Mutex<Vec<Arc<Invocation>>>,
    pub start_fault: Mutex<Option<i32>>,
    pub start_hook: Mutex<Option<StartHook>>,
    pub remove_before_start: Mutex<Option<PathBuf>>,
    pub signal_hook: Mutex<Option<SignalHook>>,
    pub checkpoint_hook: Mutex<Option<CheckHook>>,
    pub capture_gate: Mutex<Option<Arc<Gate>>>,
    pub capture_fault: AtomicBool,
    pub terminal: Mutex<Vec<TerminalRequest>>,
    pub terminal_cv: Condvar,
}
pub fn signal_os(target: SignalTarget, s: Signal) -> io::Result<()> {
    let pid = match target {
        SignalTarget::Group(p) => -(p as i32),
        SignalTarget::Leader(p) => p as i32,
    };
    match kill(Pid::from_raw(pid), s) {
        Ok(()) => Ok(()),
        Err(nix::errno::Errno::ESRCH) => Ok(()),
        Err(e) => Err(io::Error::from_raw_os_error(e as i32)),
    }
}
struct CaptureWriter<'a> {
    destination: Box<dyn Write + Send + 'a>,
    gate: Option<Arc<Gate>>,
    fault: bool,
    written: usize,
}
impl Write for CaptureWriter<'_> {
    fn write(&mut self, b: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {
        if let Some(g) = self.gate.take() {
            g.hit()
        }
        if self.fault {
            if self.written >= 3 {
                return Err(io::Error::other(Fault("injected-capture-error")));
            }
            let n = (3 - self.written).min(b.len());
            let w = self.destination.write(&b[..n])?;
            self.written += w;
            Ok(w)
        } else {
            self.destination.write(b)
        }
    }
    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
        self.destination.flush()
    }
}
impl Dependencies for Probe {
    fn start(&self, c: &mut Command) -> io::Result<Child> {
        self.starts.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        let hook = self.start_hook.lock().unwrap().clone();
        if let Some(hook) = hook {
            return hook(c);
        }
        if let Some(path) = self.remove_before_start.lock().unwrap().take() {
            std::fs::remove_file(path)?
        }
        if let Some(e) = *self.start_fault.lock().unwrap() {
            return Err(io::Error::from_raw_os_error(e));
        }
        let child = c.spawn()?;
        self.pids.lock().unwrap().push(child.id().unwrap());
        Ok(child)
    }
    fn wait<'a>(&'a self, c: &'a mut Child) -> hooks::Wait<'a> {
        self.waits.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        let pid = c.id();
        Box::pin(async move {
            let result = c.wait().await;
            self.reaped.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
            if let Ok(path) = std::env::var("P1_WAITLOG") {
                let record = format!("{}\n", pid.unwrap());
                OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path).unwrap()
                    .write_all(record.as_bytes()).unwrap();
            }
            result
        })
    }
    fn signal(&self, target: SignalTarget, s: Signal) -> io::Result<()> {
        self.signals.lock().unwrap().push((target, s));
        let hook = self.signal_hook.lock().unwrap().clone();
        match hook {
            Some(h) => h(target, s),
            None => signal_os(target, s),
        }
    }
    fn capture<'a>(&self, s: Stream, w: Box<dyn Write + Send + 'a>) -> Box<dyn Write + Send + 'a> {
        if s == Stream::Stdout {
            Box::new(CaptureWriter {
                destination: w,
                gate: self.capture_gate.lock().unwrap().clone(),
                fault: self.capture_fault.load(Ordering::SeqCst),
                written: 0,
            })
        } else {
            w
        }
    }
    fn checkpoint(&self, e: Checkpoint, i: Arc<Invocation>) {
        if e == Checkpoint::PreStart {
            self.invocations.lock().unwrap().push(i.clone())
        }
        let hook = self.checkpoint_hook.lock().unwrap().clone();
        if let Some(h) = hook {
            h(e, i)
        }
    }
    fn terminal_entered(&self, r: TerminalRequest) {
        self.terminal.lock().unwrap().push(r);
        self.terminal_cv.notify_all()
    }
}
impl Probe {
    pub fn at(&self, n: usize) -> Arc<Invocation> {
        self.invocations.lock().unwrap()[n].clone()
    }
    pub fn last(&self) -> Arc<Invocation> {
        self.invocations
            .lock()
            .unwrap()
            .last()
            .expect("pre-start invocation")
            .clone()
    }
    pub fn once(&self, n: usize) {
        assert_eq!(self.starts.load(Ordering::SeqCst), n, "start count");
        assert_eq!(self.waits.load(Ordering::SeqCst), n, "single Wait owner");
        assert_eq!(
            self.reaped.load(Ordering::SeqCst),
            n,
            "direct child reaping"
        );
        assert!(
            self.signals
                .lock()
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .all(|(_, s)| *s == Signal::SIGKILL)
        )
    }
}
pub fn runtime(p: Arc<Probe>) -> (Runtime, Bytes, Bytes) {
    let o = Bytes::default();
    let e = Bytes::default();
    let r = hooks::new_observed(p, Box::pin(o.clone()), Box::pin(e.clone())).unwrap();
    (r, o, e)
}
pub fn app(r: &Runtime) -> Arc<App> {
    r.app("companion/helper")
}
pub async fn finalized(i: &Invocation) {
    tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(4), async {
        while i.snapshot().is_none() {
            tokio::task::yield_now().await
        }
    })
    .await
    .expect("completion watchdog")
}
pub async fn join(a: &App) -> Arc<Invocation> {
    let i = a.wait().await.unwrap();
    assert!(i.snapshot().is_some(), "Await before final publication");
    assert_eq!(&*i.snapshot().unwrap().stdout, &*a.output().unwrap());
    if i.claim_continuation().unwrap() {
        i.finish_continuation()
    }
    i
}
pub fn result(i: &Arc<Invocation>, out: &[u8], err: &[u8], code: i32) {
    let s = i.snapshot().expect("final snapshot");
    assert_eq!(&*s.stdout, out);
    assert_eq!(&*s.stderr, err);
    if code == 0 {
        assert!(s.error.is_none(), "unexpected error {:?}", s.error);
        assert_eq!(s.status, Some(0))
    } else if code > 0 {
        assert!(s.error.is_some());
        assert_eq!(s.status, Some(code))
    } else {
        assert!(s.error.is_some())
    }
}
fn field(s: &str, key: &str) -> String {
    let mark = format!("\"{key}\":");
    let rest = s.split_once(&mark).unwrap().1.trim_start();
    if let Some(rest) = rest.strip_prefix('"') {
        rest.split('"').next().unwrap().to_owned()
    } else {
        rest.split([',', '}']).next().unwrap().trim().to_owned()
    }
}
pub struct Peer {
    pub label: String,
    pub record: String,
    pub pid: i32,
    pub ppid: i32,
    pub pgid: i32,
    pub socket: Mutex<Option<UnixStream>>,
    pub done: AtomicBool,
}
pub struct Controller {
    pub dir: PathBuf,
    rx: mpsc::Receiver<Arc<Peer>>,
    all: Arc<Mutex<Vec<Arc<Peer>>>>,
    closed: Arc<AtomicBool>,
}
impl Controller {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        static NEXT: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
            "p1rust-{}-{}",
            std::process::id(),
            NEXT.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst)
        ));
        std::fs::create_dir(&dir).unwrap();
        let listener = UnixListener::bind(dir.join("c")).unwrap();
        listener.set_nonblocking(true).unwrap();
        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel();
        let all = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let closed = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
        let stop = closed.clone();
        let peers = all.clone();
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            while !stop.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
                match listener.accept() {
                    Ok((conn, _)) => {
                        conn.set_nonblocking(false).unwrap();
                        let tx = tx.clone();
                        let peers = peers.clone();
                        std::thread::spawn(move || {
                            let mut reader = BufReader::new(conn.try_clone().unwrap());
                            let mut line = String::new();
                            reader.read_line(&mut line).unwrap();
                            let p = Arc::new(Peer {
                                label: field(&line, "Label"),
                                record: field(&line, "Record"),
                                pid: field(&line, "PID").parse().unwrap(),
                                ppid: field(&line, "PPID").parse().unwrap(),
                                pgid: field(&line, "PGID").parse().unwrap(),
                                socket: Mutex::new(Some(conn)),
                                done: AtomicBool::new(false),
                            });
                            peers.lock().unwrap().push(p.clone());
                            tx.send(p.clone()).unwrap();
                            // A stopped peer can reset the socket with an unread
                            // release message. Both EOF and reset disconnect it;
                            // stopped() still requires the lifetime lock released.
                            match io::copy(&mut reader, &mut io::sink()) {
                                Ok(_) => {}
                                Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::ConnectionReset => {}
                                Err(error) => panic!("controller disconnect: {error}"),
                            }
                            p.socket.lock().unwrap().take();
                            p.done.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
                        });
                    }
                    Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
                        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1))
                    }
                    Err(e) => panic!("controller accept: {e}"),
                }
            }
        });
        env("P1_SOCKET", dir.join("c"));
        Self {
            dir,
            rx,
            all,
            closed,
        }
    }
    pub fn ready(&self, labels: &[&str]) -> Vec<Arc<Peer>> {
        let mut got = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
        for _ in labels {
            let p = self
                .rx
                .recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(4))
                .expect("readiness watchdog");
            assert!(
                labels.contains(&p.label.as_str()),
                "unexpected ready {}",
                p.label
            );
            assert!(got.insert(p.label.clone(), p).is_none(), "duplicate ready")
        }
        labels.iter().map(|l| got.remove(*l).unwrap()).collect()
    }
    pub fn release(&self, p: &Peer) {
        let result = {
            let mut socket = p.socket.lock().unwrap();
            socket.as_mut().map(|socket| socket.write_all(b"release\n"))
        };
        // Stop can win before this release write. A closed socket is accepted
        // only after both disconnection and lifetime release are observed; a
        // live peer still fails the existing stopped() watchdog. Drop the socket
        // guard first so its reader can publish disconnection without deadlock.
        match result {
            Some(Ok(())) => {}
            None => self.stopped(p),
            Some(Err(error)) if matches!(error.kind(), io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe | io::ErrorKind::ConnectionReset) => self.stopped(p),
            Some(Err(error)) => panic!("release {}: {error}", p.label),
        }
    }
    pub fn alive(&self, p: &Peer) {
        assert!(!p.done.load(Ordering::SeqCst), "{} disconnected", p.label);
        assert!(
            ownership::held(
                &PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("P1_OWNERSHIP").unwrap()).join(&p.record)
            )
            .unwrap(),
            "{} lifetime released",
            p.label
        )
    }
    pub fn stopped(&self, p: &Peer) {
        let end = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(2);
        loop {
            if p.done.load(Ordering::SeqCst)
                && !ownership::held(
                    &PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("P1_OWNERSHIP").unwrap()).join(&p.record),
                )
                .unwrap()
            {
                return;
            }
            assert!(Instant::now() < end, "{} live before fallback", p.label);
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1))
        }
    }
}
impl Drop for Controller {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.closed.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
        let mut leaks = Vec::new();
        for p in self.all.lock().unwrap().iter() {
            let held = ownership::held(
                &PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("P1_OWNERSHIP").unwrap()).join(&p.record),
            )
            .unwrap_or(false);
            if held {
                leaks.push(p.label.clone());
                eprintln!(
                    "runtime leak before harness fallback: {} pid={} pgid={}",
                    p.label, p.pid, p.pgid
                );
                let _ = kill(Pid::from_raw(p.pid), Signal::SIGKILL);
            }
            if let Some(socket) = p.socket.lock().unwrap().take() {
                let _ = socket.shutdown(std::net::Shutdown::Both);
            }
        }
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&self.dir);
        if !leaks.is_empty() && !std::thread::panicking() {
            panic!("live runtime resources before fallback: {leaks:?}")
        }
    }
}
pub fn private_companion() -> (String, PathBuf) {
    static NEXT: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
    let root = std::env::current_exe()
        .unwrap()
        .parent()
        .unwrap()
        .to_path_buf();
    let name = format!(
        "companion/case-{}-{}",
        std::process::id(),
        NEXT.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst)
    );
    let path = root.join(&name);
    std::fs::copy(root.join("companion/helper"), &path).unwrap();
    (name, path)
}
